metadata.name: OpenMoHAA
metadata.summary: Play Medal of Honor: Allied Assault on modern systems with an enhanced open-source engine

content.value: OpenMoHAA is an open-source game engine reimplementation dedicated to preserving and enhancing Medal of Honor: Allied Assault, along with its Spearhead and Breakthrough expansion packs. Powered by ioquake3 and the F.A.K.K. SDK, it delivers native cross-platform support, enhanced stability, and compatibility across modern computer architectures.
The engine retains full compatibility with original game assets, scripts, and network protocols while providing critical engine bug fixes, upgraded system backends, and modern gameplay improvements.

items.value: Full compatibility with original assets, single-player campaigns, and custom scripting
Complete support for all official multiplayer modes including Free-For-All, Objective, Tug-of-War, and Liberation
Includes all official bug fixes and updates from Spearhead 2.15 and Breakthrough 2.40b
Integrated multiplayer bots and an administrative ban system
Support for popular community game modifications such as Freeze-Tag
